required_interface.construction: distinct real nodes, barycentric weights and the unique degree-at-most-n interpolating polynomial
required_interface.uniqueness: cardinal-value verification and the n+1 distinct-root bound
required_interface.remainder: f in C^(n+1) on an interval containing the distinct nodes and evaluation point; repeated-Rolle remainder with exact node factors
required_interface.finite_evaluator: sorted distinct nodes and finite data; duplicate-node and invalid arithmetic-range inputs return explicit failure statuses

suppliers.source_excerpt:
def-cardinal-polynomial-interpolation, Definition: “Let $n\in\mathbb N$ with $n\ge0$, let $x_0<\cdots<x_n$ be distinct real nodes, and let $y_0,\ldots,y_n\in\mathbb R$.”

thm-cardinal-polynomial-interpolant-exists-uniquely, Statement: “Then $I_n y$ from [[def-cardinal-polynomial-interpolation]] is the unique real polynomial of degree at most $n$ satisfying $p(x_i)=y_i$ for every $i=0,\ldots,n$.”

thm-barycentric-interpolation-identities, Statement: “At a node $x_i$, the interpolant is defined by the separate value $I_n y(x_i)=y_i$; the quotient is not used there.”

thm-lagrange-interpolation-remainder, Statement: “If $x=x_j$ for a node, then $f(x)-p(x)=0$.” and “If $x\in[a,b]$ is not a node, there is $$\xi\in\bigl(\min\{x,x_0\},\max\{x,x_n\}\bigr)$$ such that $$f(x)-p(x)=\frac{f^{(n+1)}(\xi)}{(n+1)!_{\mathbb R}}\,\omega_n(x).$$”

alg-finite-barycentric-interpolation-evaluator, Definition: “The output is either a record with status *success* and a value in $\mathbb F$, or one of the statuses *invalid_nodes*, *invalid_data*, and *range_failure*.”

prop-finite-barycentric-interpolation-evaluator-returns-status, Statement: “For every input tuple of [[alg-finite-barycentric-interpolation-evaluator]], the procedure terminates and returns one of its declared statuses.”
